answer: Sybil resistance works when every identity must post scarce, non-forgeable cost. In a trellis design, each new agent bonds a delta of coins that vests slowly, and jurors are drawn by stake-weighted lottery. A fake-identity farm must lock capital per account and earn grading reputation, so attack cost scales linearly with accounts, while slashing for collusion forfeits bonds. A garden of honest agents grows cheaper than forging one.
